summary: Static refresh found no actionable defect in the bounded dispatch/continuation correction. Socket poll waits now suspend Swift tasks while retaining connection accounting and descriptor ownership. The constrained-executor regression checks useful EvidenceStore progress while all four slow peers remain admitted. This review supersedes the earlier backend snapshot reviews.
evidence: E1: /private/tmp/disk-steward-541-accepted.uaJBzS/Sources/DiskStewardCore/IPC/UnixSocketEvidenceServer.swift:175-178,310-317,378-380,439-451; each admitted connection sequentially awaits its read and writes on the dedicated concurrent dispatch queue. Admission is capped and cancelled connections retain slots, so outstanding I/O operations remain bounded by maximumConnections.

E2: Same server:277-298,336-370,439-442; stop/watchdog mark work cancelled and shut down without closing worker fds. The continuation resumes exactly once with either the operation result or thrown error. Task cancellation cannot prematurely run the worker defer while dispatched I/O still owns access to its descriptor; worker close follows awaited completion.

E3: Frozen Sources/DiskStewardCore/IPC/DiskStewardIPCClient.swift:170-233; sockets are nonblocking and poll waits repeatedly check the shared revocation predicate and absolute deadline. The dispatched operations do not depend on inheriting Swift task cancellation. Frozen Sources/DiskStewardApp/MCPAccess/MCPAccessController.swift:71-109 retains the same service/accounting across Off/On.

E4: Frozen Tests/DiskStewardAppTests/IPC/RequestCancellationTests.swift:7-76,222-225; separate children enable LIBDISPATCH_COOPERATIVE_POOL_STRICT=1 for idle, partial and nonreading peers. The synchronous child admits four peers, schedules an actual utility-priority EvidenceStore query, requires completion within one second while all four remain counted, and uses a two-MiB response for nonreaders. Child failure/timeout propagates to the parent test.

E5: Frozen SQLiteConnection.swift:74-114,132-177 retains cancellation-aware SQLite hooks, protected rollback, bounded backup stepping and deferred backup finish/close. Server:340-348 retains POLLOUT hangup detection rather than read-EOF or peek-based abandonment inference.
